title: Modern Island Getaway w/ Heated Pool, Bar & Gazebo
description:
Experience Ultimate Vacation Vibes at our 5-bedroom modern home, complete with spa-like bathrooms, stylish loft with queen bed, backyard with a heated(add charge)pool with basketball hoop, bar area, and a garage with ping pong table and bikes. Located in a secure area with top restaurants, shopping, and entertainment just minutes away. Ideal for families or groups, our home offers the perfect balance of relaxation and entertainment

✔ Heated Pool
✔ Gazebo
✔ Luxurious Bathrooms

Learn more below!

 The space 
Welcome to our stunning Airbnb, located at 3776 E Sexton Street in Gilbert, AZ. This luxurious property features five beautiful bedrooms, three modern bathrooms, a stylishly decorated laundry room, a loft perfect for working or relaxing, and a backyard designed for fun and relaxation.

The backyard is the perfect place to enjoy the sunshine and unwind with family and friends. You can entertain guests at the built-in bar and BBQ area, take a dip in the 10x30 heated saltwater pool or chill out in the gazebo or outdoor sofa. As night falls, the backyard comes alive with stunning lighting both in and out of the pool.

In addition, the garage is a fun space where guests can enjoy a game of ping pong, use the bikes to explore the local area, shoot some hoops with the basketball hoop in the driveway or play a game of cornhole.

The location is perfect, situated just minutes away from many of Gilbert's top attractions, including the SanTan Village Mall, Topgolf, Downtown Gilbert, Freestone Park, and the Riparian Preserve. If you're looking for a delicious meal, some of the top restaurants in the area include Joyride Taco House, Pomo Pizzeria Napoletana, and Postino WineCafe. Plus, the Verde at Cooley Station is a new walkable development that offers a variety of shops, dining options, and entertainment.

Our Airbnb offers a perfect blend of relaxation, luxury, and entertainment that is sure to make your stay a memorable one.
✔ 3 Luxurious Bathrooms
✔ Sleeps up to 10 Guests
✔ Beautiful Backyard with Pool
✔ 5☆ Resort Comforts

❖ LIVING ROOM ❖

Welcome to our Airbnb living room, the ultimate destination for relaxation and entertainment. At the heart of this cozy space, you'll find a magnificent 85" Smart TV mounted on the wall, offering a stunning visual experience for your viewing pleasure. Whether you're looking to catch up on your favorite shows or watch a blockbuster movie, this TV will provide an immersive and cinematic experience like no other. The seating options are equally as impressive, with two beautiful plush sofas and a snuggle chair arranged around a large footrest, creating the perfect hub for lounging and socializing. Sink into the comfortable cushions and enjoy the company of your loved ones, or simply take some time for yourself to unwind and decompress. Whatever your preference, our living room is the perfect place to relax, have fun and create unforgettable memories.

✔ Two Comfortable Sofas 
✔ One Snuggle Sofa

✔ Thoughtful Decor

❖️ KITCHEN & DINING ❖ 

Step into our fully equipped kitchen, the perfect place to unleash your inner chef and prepare delicious meals for yourself and your loved ones. This kitchen is packed with everything you need to create a full gourmet dinner or simply brew a quick cup of coffee, all while enjoying the cozy and warm feeling created by the dark wood worktop of the large island and the white kitchen units. The stainless steel appliances only add to the modern and sleek aesthetic, making this a home chef's dream. You'll love cooking in this well-stocked kitchen and creating new culinary masterpieces to share with your family and friends. Once you're finished cooking, head over to the dining room where you'll be welcomed by a large dining table that comfortably seats up to 8 people. This is the perfect setting to serve up your delicious kitchen creations and feast with your loved ones. Whether you're looking to entertain guests or simply enjoy a cozy family dinner, our kitchen and dining area are the perfect place to do so.

❖️ SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS ❖ 

Welcome to our stunning Airbnb bedrooms, where you'll find the perfect space to unwind and get a great night's sleep. Each of our five bedrooms is designed with comfort and beauty in mind and provides ample storage for your clothes and belongings. Let's start with bedroom number 1, situated downstairs and fitted with a cozy queen-sized bed and its own smart TV, this room provides a cozy and private retreat.

Moving on to bedroom number 2, also located downstairs and equipped with a queen-sized bed, this room offers a tranquil space to sink into the soft, white sheets and rejuvenate after a long day exploring.

Next, we have bedroom number 3, located upstairs and furnished with a comfortable queen-sized bed and a TV mounted on the wall, perfect for enjoying some late-night entertainment before drifting off to sleep.

Step into bedroom number 4, which is perfect for families, with a double bed and twin bunk bed configuration, as well as another TV mounted on the wall for maximum entertainment right from the bed.

Lastly, we have our stunning master bedroom, bedroom number 5, featuring a luxurious king-sized bed, a walk-in closet, a private ensuite, and of course, a TV mounted on the wall for your viewing pleasure. With our spacious and comfortable bedrooms, you'll have everything you need to get a quality night's sleep and feel right at home.

If you need additional blankets or pillows, just ask!

❖️ BATHROOMS ❖

Welcome to our beautiful Airbnb bathrooms, where you'll find the perfect space to refresh and recharge. Let's start downstairs, where you'll find a modern and stylish bathroom featuring a glass walk-in tiled shower with plenty of room to move around. With a great vanity and mirror combo, you'll have all the space you need to get ready for your day or night out.

Moving on to the upstairs guest bathroom, you'll find a sleek and modern space that features a bathtub and shower combination. With a large mirror and lots of sink space, you'll have all the room you need for your toiletries and personal items.

Finally, we have the stunning ensuite bathroom in the master bedroom, designed to provide you with the ultimate luxury experience. With a huge walk-in shower and modern design, this bathroom features three drenchers and a small bench, allowing you to relax and wash away the stresses of the day. The two sinks provide ample space for you and your partner to get ready in style. Whether you're looking to freshen up or unwind, our Airbnb bathrooms have everything you need to feel comfortable and pampered.

❖️ LOFT & WORKSPACE ❖ 

Step right up to our loft, the perfect space for anyone who needs to get some work done during their stay. With a dedicated work area, you'll have everything you need to check emails, finish off projects, or simply catch up on some reading. But that's not all - we've also made sure that there's plenty of space for relaxation and play. Whether you're traveling with kids or just need a break from your work, the comfortable futon is the perfect place to kick back and unwind. And if you do have little ones with you, they'll love the nearby play section, which is just a few steps away. So whether you need to get some work done or simply want to relax and have fun, our loft is the perfect place to do it all.

❖ BACKYARD ❖

Step out into our stunning backyard, where you'll find the perfect place to entertain and relax. The bar area, accessed from the living room, boasts a built-in BBQ - ideal for cooking up some mouth-watering burgers or sausages. Take a seat on one of the 4 stools, enjoy a refreshing drink and soak up the warm sun.

Just behind the bar seating, you'll find a cozy gazebo - the perfect place to escape the sun and relax on the outdoor sofa, chatting with friends and family.

And if you're looking to take a dip, our gorgeous 10x30 heated salt water pool awaits you. With a basketball hoop, it's perfect for a friendly game or tournament. There's plenty of seating around the pool too, perfect for soaking up the sun, and you can even place some of the chairs in the pool's shallow area for a refreshing, cool-down experience.

As night falls, the backyard comes to life with stunning lighting both in and out of the pool. With a range of colors to choose from, it's the perfect way to end a long day of exploration or simply relax with a glass of wine.

❖ GARAGE GAMES ❖

Step into our garage and continue the entertainment with our sound system whilst playing on the ping pong table, a great way to spend quality time with family and friends. If you're feeling more adventurous, take a ride on one of our bikes to explore the beautiful area around the property. The long driveway is perfect for a friendly game of basketball, and we even have a cornhole set for some competitive fun.

❖ LAUNDRY ❖

At our Airbnb, we believe that even the laundry room should be a stylish and inviting space. That's why we've decorated it with bright, beautiful colors that make the space feel warm and welcoming. Not only is it practical and convenient to have access to a washer and dryer during your stay, but we've made sure that the laundry room is a place where you'll actually enjoy spending time. With plenty of space to move around and a stylish décor that reflects the rest of the property, you'll find that doing laundry has never been more enjoyable. Say goodbye to the stress and hassle of finding a laundromat or worrying about lugging dirty clothes back home. Our laundry room makes it easy to keep your clothes clean and fresh throughout your stay, so you can focus on making the most of your time in this wonderful location.
